authoredCards.body:
Full Moons bring what has been building into clearer view. In Aquarius, that may be the friendship that only works because one person keeps organizing everything, the group plan everyone agrees with but no one supports, or the role you accepted years ago that no one has checked to see if you still want.

Aquarius is a fixed air sign ruled by Saturn. It can step back from the immediate emotion and see how the larger system works. Who makes the decisions? Who carries the responsibility? Who is expected to adjust? That distance is useful when you need to see the pattern clearly. Taken too far, it can become detachment, rigid thinking, or loyalty to a principle long after it stops helping the people involved.

The Sun in Leo sits opposite this Moon, bringing personal recognition into tension with the expectations of the group. You may notice where you have been waiting for approval, staying loyal to a familiar role, or agreeing with a plan because you do not want to risk your place in the room. If belonging depends on staying quiet or continuing to play the same part, that arrangement becomes harder to defend. You may also see where a group has been happy to use your work while treating your need for credit as an ego problem.

Saturn gives this Full Moon weight. The problem probably did not begin this week. It may be the same limitation everyone keeps working around, the responsibility that keeps returning to the same person, or the future plan that still sounds good but has no budget, deadline, or clear owner.

Clarity does not require a decision on the same day. Let the information settle. Notice what needs new terms, what both sides are willing to repair, and what has reached its limit.

Aries is cardinal fire ruled by Mars, so what comes up now does not arrive politely. The heat is data: it points at the exact place a limit was crossed and nobody said so.

The Sun in Libra holds the other end: the relationship, the agreement, the appearance of harmony. The tension is not selfishness against love. It is if the current terms require one person to disappear in installments.

Say the direct sentence. Anger that gets a clear channel becomes a boundary; anger that does not becomes an ambush later.

Capricorn is cardinal earth ruled by Saturn, and what rises now is structural: which ambitions are load-bearing and which are just heavy.

The Sun in Cancer holds the other end: home, family, the life the work was supposed to fund. The tension is between the mountain and the reason you started climbing it.

Renegotiate one standing obligation before it renews by default. The career that costs the whole life is not success; it is an unexamined contract.

Gemini is mutable air ruled by Mercury: the pressure here is verbal, and it breaks as words: the message finally sent, the question finally asked in plain terms, the sentence you have rehearsed for a month said in fifteen seconds.

The Sun in Sagittarius holds the other end: the big claim, the belief, the meaning of it all. The tension is between the details you know and the story you have been telling over them.

Say the specific sentence, not the speech. One accurate detail moves more than the whole defended narrative.

(Engine note: the Sun rules Leo and participates in every lunation; skip rule active, no ruler line.)

Take the credit that has your name on it, and give the specific praise you have been rationing. Recognition is not a scarce resource; treating it like one is the actual problem.

Full moons are about illuminating that unconscious and that which is unseen. The Pisces full moon asks you, "what is fantasy and what is real?" During this powerful Pisces full moon, the wall between your dreams, emotions, and reality may collide.

Pisces is a deeply intuitive and empathetic sign, with a strong connection to the spiritual realm. However, when not fully evolved, Pisces energy can manifest as suffering, with thin boundaries that make them vulnerable to the emotional turmoil of the world around them.

The Virgo sun and Pisces moon are here to be your source of wisdom, pushing you to be practical while at the same time infusing your heart with compassion and understanding. The Virgo sun lights your way, guiding you on practicality and self-care and showing you where you're doing something that is not in your best interests. Meanwhile, the Pisces moon brings gentle understanding, highlights where you are too hard on yourself, and when you need to bring compassion into your heart.

There may be some difficult emotions and unresolved issues you are forced to confront. Remember that the only way out of darkness is through it.

Book the concrete version of one belief: the trip, the course, the conversation with the mentor. A philosophy with no departure date is a decoration.

New Moons begin a six-month cycle, and what starts now grows on the terms you set first. In Aries, the terms are speed and ownership: this beginning belongs to whoever moves first, and it loses power every day it waits for a better moment. The right start here is closer to a first step than a plan.

Aries is cardinal fire ruled by Mars. The beginning it favors is direct: ask the person, send the application, sign up, start training. Mars does not negotiate with hesitation; it converts it into frustration, and frustration into either action or resentment.

The risk is the false start. Aries opens strong and delegates the follow-through to a future self who never agreed to it. Do not confuse the rush of deciding with the work of doing.

Start one concrete effort this week and give it a move you can finish before the weekend. Momentum is easier to keep than to restart.

New Moons begin a six-month cycle, and what starts now grows on the terms you set first. In Leo, those terms are personal. This beginning will not function as a committee decision, an audience poll, or a favor to keep someone else comfortable. It has to be owned, signed, and visibly yours.

Leo is fixed fire ruled by the Sun. The Sun is at home here, which means the only start it honors is the one driven by genuine, unmanufactured desire. Ask yourself what you would still build if nobody was watching, and what you would refuse to abandon the moment public attention moves elsewhere. That is the test to run before you commit. Strip the audience away: if the work still feels vital, it is yours; if it goes cold, you were doing it for applause.

The shadow here is defensive pride. Leo energy wants to protect a plan early, sometimes long before there is an actual result to show for it. Validation feels good, but it makes a hollow foundation.

Start the project that carries your name comfortably. When the work is genuinely yours, you never have to spend your energy defending its right to exist.

authoredCards.body:
You do not need another plan for becoming a better version of yourself. You may need to stop treating every difficult part of your life as evidence that you need fixing.

New Moons begin a six-month cycle, and a Virgo New Moon brings your attention to the systems holding ordinary life together: your routines, responsibilities, health, work, and all the small decisions that make everything else possible. This is where you notice what keeps taking more effort than it should, what has become difficult to maintain, and what only works because you keep compensating for it.

Virgo is ruled by Mercury, but its intelligence is practical. It notices what is useful, what is wasting your time, and what could work better with a small adjustment. Sometimes progress is realizing that the routine you keep failing at was never built for the life you actually have.

The harder lesson is recognizing when improvement has become another way to criticize yourself. You can keep refining the plan, raising the standard, and finding one more thing to fix until nothing you do feels finished. Perfectionism can look like discipline and responsibility while quietly making you dissatisfied with everything you accomplish.

This New Moon does not need you to overhaul your life. Change something that would make your days work better for the person you are now. The next six months do not need a flawless plan. They need a life that does not require you to keep treating yourself as the problem.

hookRows.body_you: Aries is the first sign of the zodiac, cardinal fire ruled by Mars, and its symbol is the ram. The zodiac's story starts here, at the spring equinox, when light comes back and everything green pushes up through cold ground. Aries carries that push: the nerve to begin, to want, to go first. The stereotype is the hothead. The older story is the spark that gets the whole wheel turning.

The stereotype is the perfectionist with the label maker. The older story is the healer and the craftsperson, the one who loves something enough to tend its details.

hookRows.body_you: A Capricorn Full Moon runs a little more somber and serious than most, and that is the point. Capricorn is the Mountain Goat, climbing slowly and surely toward the goal and dealing with whatever boulder is in the way. The emphasis falls on the balance between home and career, and between respecting your elders and living your own truth. Expect a maturity upgrade: more responsibility landing in your health, your home, your work, or your dealings with authority. If you have done the climb, this is the Moon where the hard work gets recognized. If you have been resisting a change out of fear, this Moon can force the growing up instead, and past actions may come back asking to be answered for. Feeling alone in it, like you only have yourself to lean on, can surface too. That is Capricorn energy doing its job: it pushes you to mature, and it reorganizes your structures onto a foundation that will actually hold.

hookRows.body_you:
An Aquarius Full Moon shows you how the arrangement actually works. Saturn rules Aquarius, so the focus falls on responsibility, limits, and the rules everyone has been following, including the ones nobody remembers agreeing to.

You may notice that the same person keeps organizing the group, covering the missing work, or adjusting their schedule so the plan can continue. A friendship, agreement, or long-term goal may still exist, but that does not mean the current version of it is working.

Aquarius is fixed air. It can step back from the immediate emotion and see the pattern clearly. It can also keep defending a principle after the circumstances have changed. The fixed signs are involved, so check your grip. Commitment matters. So does knowing when loyalty has become an excuse to avoid a necessary conversation.

What has been building may become easier to name now. You do not have to make the final decision at the same speed. Let the information settle before one difficult conversation becomes the reason to end the entire arrangement. Which commitments still deserve your effort? Where has staying quiet become the price of belonging?

hookRows.body_you: An Aries Full Moon pulls you back into your own body. Aries was born to assert itself and prove its worth, and this Moon lights up the boundary between me and them: what you need and want from others, weighed against what they need and want from you. Tension in partnerships, especially around home and family, comes up now so it can be released. Approach the balancing with curiosity and kindness instead of judgment, toward yourself included. The warrior and the peacemaker need each other: without the fight there is no peace worth keeping, and without peace the fight consumes the fighter. If the balance between self and other cannot be struck, this Moon says it plainly: it is time for major changes.

hookRows.body_you: A Taurus Full Moon brings grounding to the most intense season of the year. It lights the hidden parts of yourself and sets opposing perspectives and relationships on the table, asking for balance and compromise. The axis runs between your inner sense of security and the outer one: love versus obsession, debt versus abundance, the known ground versus the unknown deep. Expect a few shocking truths and some breakdowns in things that were already cracked, because this Moon breaks things down to break through, moving stuck energy toward change and liberation. Your emotions are powerful guides right now, even the uncomfortable ones. Let the solid Taurus ground hold you while you look at what Scorpio season digs up.

hookRows.body_you: A Gemini Full Moon forms the axis of the mind: the Gemini Moon watches the details, the grains of sand, while the Sagittarius Sun holds the big picture, the whole sandbox. Both are after the same thing, the truth. This Moon asks you to pay attention to the small distinctions while staying open-minded about what they add up to, blending reason with intuition instead of choosing one. The lower roads of this axis are overthinking, scattering yourself, leaning only on logic, or floating off into idealism. The higher road gives you a clearer view of your purpose. Watch what you say and how you name things this week, because language is where this Moon does its work.

hookRows.body_you: A Cancer Full Moon lands in the middle of Capricorn season and asks you to soften. It is a time to nurture and nourish your emotional self, to find comfort in the stillness and darkness, and to tend the seeds you planted at the New Moon like a delicate plant in the dead of winter. The axis is foundation and structure: Cancer is the emotional foundation, Capricorn the outer structure, and both are after the same thing, security. Take stock of home, family, and career, and where something is not feeding you, nurture it first. If it cannot be healed, Capricorn's lesson applies: recognize that its time has passed, and let it go with discipline instead of blame. Self-care needs no excuses. Stop waiting for someone else to provide the comfort, and nurture yourself and the people who nurture you.

hookRows.body_you: A Leo Full Moon is a call to live from the heart. Leo rules the heart and spine, the center of your body and the source of your warmth, and this Moon reminds you to find your passion and follow it with the generosity of a big open heart, the kind that gives like the Sun. The axis runs between rebellion and validation, the individual and the community: Aquarius asks how your gifts can serve something bigger, and Leo answers that you get to shine while doing it. The needs of the individual and the group are not mutually exclusive. Take a risk, step out of the comfort zone, and let yourself be childlike and expressive without judgment. Validation is not always necessary. Where has your heart been waiting for permission?

hookRows.body_you: A Virgo Full Moon raises awareness and turns it toward self-care and personal growth. This is the Moon for new healthy habits: clear the physical and mental clutter that has been blocking you, organize your space, take stock of your work and your health, and make the list. Reflect on where you were six months ago, what you were working toward, and adjust. Virgo's discipline is what turns a dream into reality, step by step, routine by routine, so use this Moon to build the routines that carry your bigger intentions. Care for the body doing the work: real food, real rest, and attention to who you share your energy with. Small and consistent is the whole point.

hookRows.body_you: A Libra Full Moon reminds you that your journey through life is not meant to be walked alone: shared with others, the road gets richer. The axis is self and other, warrior and peacemaker: what you need and want from people, balanced against what they need and want from you. Finding that balance usually takes negotiation and compromise, and this Moon rewards both. It is honest about the other outcome too: when balance cannot be achieved, this energy calls for separation or an ending. Release the tension that has been building in your partnerships, especially around home and family, and let go of what has stopped being fair. Harmony is not the absence of needs. It is two sets of needs finally spoken out loud.

hookRows.body_you: A Scorpio Full Moon takes you into the deep end: loss, the unknown, other people's money, obsession, and the transformative power hiding in all of them. The axis runs between the tangible and the intangible: Taurus holds the ground, the body, and the bank account, while Scorpio digs at what is underneath them. Themes come in pairs now: love versus obsession, debt versus abundance, groundedness versus the unknown, trauma versus nurturance. Confront the shadow this Moon shows you and let it transform what it touches, then use the Taurus ground to stabilize what remains. Notice your own power and how you use it with others. What you release under this Moon tends to release all the way.

hookRows.body_you: A Sagittarius Full Moon lights up the mind and the path. Sagittarius is the natural philosopher, on a relentless hunt for the truth inside life's mysteries, and this Moon invites you to reread your own story the same way. Look at a past wound or fear through the lens of wisdom: the heartbreak that taught you your emotional needs, the failure that revealed a strength you did not know you had. Those lessons are the hidden treasure this Moon calls forth, and they open doors to healing, breakthroughs, and a fresh direction. Like a torch through the dark corners, it shows you the wisdom you have been sidestepping. Dare to ask the bigger question of your own experience: what was this actually teaching me?

hookRows.body_you:
A Pisces Full Moon shows you exactly where the story you tell yourself and the reality on the ground have split apart. Jupiter rules Pisces, so the spotlight hits faith, generosity, and the excuses that keep an unsustainable situation running: the potential you keep extending credit to, the person you describe by who they could be instead of who they are, or the sacrifice that runs on habit rather than love.

You may realize you have been quietly paying the entire bill: covering the difference, softening the impact, and translating someone else's silence into reassurance. Compassion takes real energy, and Pisces gives it away without a timesheet. That is why the total cost shocks you when it finally lands.

Mutable water does not force a dramatic fight; it simply stops feeding what gives nothing back. Which parts of the dream hold up when you state them in plain facts? Keep those. Whatever you can only defend in soft focus is already over.
source_keys: Lunation sign packages batch 3 — the next three events

hookRows.body_you: An Aries New Moon plants the year's boldest seeds. This is the New Moon for coming back into your own power: name what ignites you and make a clear plan to go get it. Aries rules the fresh start, so choose the beginning you have been postponing and give it a first step you can take this week. Watch the sign's shadow while you plant: impatience, impulsiveness, and the anger that flares when your needs go unspoken. Boundaries are part of the intention here. Wanting what you want is not selfish. Abandoning yourself to be accepted is the real cost.

hookRows.body_you: A Taurus New Moon plants slow-growing seeds: money, foundation, skill, and worth. Set intentions about what you are building, connect with the earth while you do it, and let beauty and nature be part of the practice, because Taurus manifests through the senses. A strong foundation is the intention underneath every other one here. Be patient with the timeline: what this Moon starts is meant to still be standing in years, not weeks. The caution is comfort itself. Do not plant more padding around a life that has stopped fitting.

hookRows.body_you: A Gemini New Moon plants seeds directly in the mind. Mercury rules this Moon, so anchor your goals in words. Write them out and say them aloud, using clear language to bring order to the chaos. Feed your curiosity deliberately with a course, a reading list, or an unexplored block in your own neighborhood. The main caution is scattering your attention. Ten half-started projects yield less than three tended daily, so focus on the conversations and ideas that actually merit your bandwidth.

hookRows.body_you: A Cancer New Moon plants emotional seeds. Ruled by the Moon herself, this is the reset for your inner life: set the emotional tone you want for the cycle, the way you want to feel at home, the way you want to mother yourself. Intentions here are quieter than most, tended in privacy and rhythm rather than announced. Care for the container first: the home, the bed, the kitchen, the people who make you feel safe. The caution is the shell. Protecting your feelings is wise, but a shell no one is ever allowed inside stops being protection and starts being loneliness.

hookRows.body_you:
A Leo New Moon is for starting what you actually want, not the diluted version you present to look reasonable. The Sun rules Leo, so this beginning runs on honest desire: the project you choose in private, the authority you stop waiting for someone to hand you, or the creative pleasure you restore to a life that has turned into pure maintenance.

This is where you give concrete hours to work that carries your imprint, claim space without apologizing for it, and stop hiding your ambition behind humility. Fixed fire commits from the heart, and it holds its ground. That is the strength and the warning: choose carefully, because what you start here will stick.

The trap is performing for an audience. If you cannot name what you want without checking who is watching, you are not ready to begin. What would you build if nobody ever saw the middle?

hookRows.body_you:
A Virgo New Moon is for fixing what you have been working around. Mercury rules Virgo, so the starting line is concrete and specific: the daily routine you rebuild, the appointment you stop rescheduling, or the recurring problem you solve at the source instead of managing every afternoon.

This is the health habit started at a scale your body can actually sustain, the workspace cleared so your daily labor stops fighting clutter, or the cold comparison of where your time actually goes versus where you claim it goes.

The shadow is relentless self-criticism. Virgo spots the flaw immediately, and turned inward without boundaries, that skill turns a fresh start into an inventory of personal failures. You are not a project to be debugged. Pick one practical process, make it five percent better, and let the result speak for itself. What is the one small fix you keep postponing because it is not impressive enough to post about? Start there.

hookRows.body_you: A Libra New Moon plants seeds in your relationships. Reflect on the balance in each one: are you giving and receiving in fair measure, or bending the truth and swallowing discomfort to keep the peace? Set intentions for harmony that is real, the kind built on honesty instead of your silence. This Moon looks at codependency, trust, old childhood wounds, and power dynamics. For some connections the planting deepens commitment, and for others it starts the honest parting. Plant fairness, in both directions. The caution is losing yourself in the other. A relationship that requires your disappearance is not balance.

hookRows.body_you: A Scorpio New Moon plants seeds in the deep. This is the Moon of transformation: face a fear around intimacy, name a pattern you inherited, and let something old finish dying so the new can begin. Mars gives this Moon courage and Pluto gives it depth, and together they hand you raw power to work with. Plant vulnerability on purpose: one truth shared with someone who has earned it. Connect with the ones who came before you if that is part of your practice. The caution is holding the shadows alone. What you face honestly under this Moon transforms. What you keep hidden keeps its grip.

hookRows.body_you: A Sagittarius New Moon plants seeds of meaning. Set intentions about the unknown you want to walk into: the trip, the study, the belief you are ready to test against the world. Trust your own intuition over outside approval, and speak your truth with conviction while you plant, because Jupiter expands whatever this Moon touches. That is also the caution: it expands everything, including overcommitment and the escape hatch. Plant one horizon, not five. Gratitude and honesty are the fertilizer here, and the middle of the road deserves the same fire as the start.

hookRows.body_you: The Capricorn New Moon is about foundational work. Set ambitious targets and commit to the climb, knowing effort is the price of admission. Structure is the strategy: the plan, the schedule, the immediate next step. When doubt arrives, which is a guarantee under Saturn, use it as useful feedback instead of an obstacle. Ask what it's actually measuring. Track your physical body, as well, because Capricorn carries unexpressed pressure in the bones and muscles. The main trap is tunnel vision. Feeling stuck is almost always a perspective error before it's an actual dead end.

hookRows.body_you:
An Aquarius New Moon is useful for changing the rules before the old arrangement becomes permanent. Saturn rules Aquarius, so the beginning needs more than a good idea. It needs a plan, clear responsibilities, and limits that everyone understands.

This may be the new group where one person is not expected to do all the organizing, the project with an actual budget and deadline, or the agreement that finally says what happens when someone does not follow through. Aquarius thinks beyond the immediate moment. It looks at the structure and asks if people can still live with it six months from now.

The caution is distance. Stepping back can help you see the pattern, but it can also become a way to avoid participating. Do not build a future you only want to advise from the sidelines. Choose one change that requires your time, your presence, and your share of the responsibility.

hookRows.body_you: A Pisces New Moon plants seeds in the dream. Let yourself be vulnerable with your feelings, alone or with someone trusted, and plant the artistic project that keeps resurfacing. The caution is the fog. Dreaming is the gift, dissolving is the risk, so tie each Pisces intention to one concrete act in the waking world.

hookRows.body_you:
Desire wants an actual target, not an abstract ideal, and drive keeps shifting the coordinates. With Venus in Virgo square Mars in Gemini, we get the push to connect and the pull to move on at the same time. A message left on read, a plan changed mid-sentence, the extra shift agreed to before anyone knows why - the timing is just a little off, and the mood never quite syncs up. Venus in Virgo weighs every signal for real value; Mars in Gemini keeps the options circling, ready to pivot or bail.

We try to turn desire into action and end up tangled in missed cues and double takes. The same charge that makes us magnetic also burns up patience, and what could be easy chemistry becomes a string of second guesses. Wanting and doing are not synonyms, and the lag between them gets loud. The urge is real. The timing is not.

hookRows.body_you:
Experience learned the hard way becomes useful to other people.

Someone who learned how to stretch a tight budget, rebuild after losing ground, or quiet the panic of having less gets asked what they know. With Chiron in Taurus sextile the North Node in Aquarius, practical knowledge about money, food, shelter, and basic material survival gives a group the framework it needs for a better plan.

It starts small: a question after a meeting, an introduction, a seat at the planning table. Older doubts may still linger, but the room sees concrete value in what was learned the hard way.

hookRows.body_you:
Something you expected to cause a fight may get a much more open response.

A total career change gets mentioned almost casually and someone immediately knows who you should talk to. An opinion you have kept to yourself for years finally comes out, and half the room starts nodding. A choice you assumed everyone would hate gets met with a practical, unbothered response. This aspect can make unusual decisions easier to say out loud, especially the ones that break a familiar rule or take you somewhere other people did not expect.

A lot of desire stays hidden because we already know the argument we think it will start. But once it is said plainly, the situation can change. The right people finally know what you want. Then they can actually respond to it.

hookRows.body_you:

We keep the conversation pleasant and leave wishing we had said what we wanted; attraction lands outside the life that looks sensible on paper, or a small request receives a sharper no than anyone expected. With Venus in Virgo square Lilith in Sagittarius, desire is being edited for usefulness and good judgment while the banished want refuses to stay reasonable.

The pressure to keep everything appropriate is working against the appetite that will not ask permission. What looks sensible on paper may not match what the body actually wants.

Someone who stayed quiet for far too long finally drops the polite filter and says what was being held back. With Mars in Gemini opposite Lilith in Sagittarius, fast replies collide with opinions and convictions held back too long.

The latest comment is not the real issue, only the spark. The reaction carries the full weight of how long people have been holding their breath.
